title: Starfield
provenance: Reported by tomislav (highball#352, 2026-10-15), Apple M1 Max, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.15, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r26, D3DMetal: the game runs, with blocky shadows in some scenes (screenshots on the issue). Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Runs on D3DMetal on the default engine (DirectX 12 only, so D3DMetal is the mode). Some shadows come out blocky with stair-stepped edges, seen inside a ship on an M1 Max. Whether D3DMetal 4 (the Wine 11 engines r24 and r26 on macOS 27) draws them differently is not known yet.

knownIssues.symptom: Blocky, stair-stepped shadows in some scenes (M1 Max, D3DMetal 3)
knownIssues.fix: none known. Untested: the Wine 11 engine r24 or r26, which carry D3DMetal 4
